(()=>{const s=window.__qaProvider;if(!s||s.error)throw Error('Provider probe failed: '+JSON.stringify(s));if(!s.available)throw Error('Provider unavailable');if(s.model!=='MiniMax-M3')throw Error('Wrong model: '+s.model);return JSON.stringify({provider:s.provider,model:s.model,stored:localStorage.getItem('xray:assistant-provider:v2')})})()
(()=>{const s=window.__qaSeed;if(!s)throw Error('Seed never resolved');if(!s.ok)throw Error('Seed failed: '+s.error);return JSON.stringify(s)})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('textarea[placeholder^="Ask anything"]'))return 'already-open';const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Live assistant');if(!b)throw Error('No Live assistant launcher');b.click();return 'opened'})()
(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Add to assistant"]');if(!b)throw Error('No add-to-assistant trigger');b.click();return 'menu opened'})()

(()=>{const root=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Add to assistant menu"]');if(!root)throw Error('Add menu is not open');const b=[...root.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"]')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==="New chat");if(!b)throw Error('No menu item: '+"New chat");if(b.disabled)throw Error('Menu item disabled: '+"New chat");b.click();return 'clicked '+"New chat"})()
(()=>{const f=window.__qaEmpty;if(!f.ok)throw Error('Conversation was not empty before the turn: '+JSON.stringify(f));return JSON.stringify({conversationEmptyBeforeTurn:true,activeId:f.activeId})})()

(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('textarea[placeholder^="Ask anything"]');if(!t)throw Error('No composer');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set.call(t,"Execute calculate_draft_roof_sheet_coverage for this explicit QA rectangle: developedWidthM='8', developedRunM='9.8', effectiveCoverM='0.8', orderLengthM='5', endLapM='0.2', measurementReference='QA synthetic rectangle', supplierReference='QA supplied sheet specification'. Report the actual tool result and explain course steps and lap policy. Use supplied inputs only; do not change project or geometry.");t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return 'composed ' + t.value.length + ' chars'})()
(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Add to assistant"]');if(!b)throw Error('No add-to-assistant trigger');b.click();return 'menu opened'})()

(()=>{const root=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Add to assistant menu"]');if(!root)throw Error('Add menu is not open');const b=[...root.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"]')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==="Projects");if(!b)throw Error('No menu item: '+"Projects");if(b.disabled)throw Error('Menu item disabled: '+"Projects");b.click();return 'clicked '+"Projects"})()

(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('.assistant-project-new');if(!b)throw Error('No New project button');if(b.disabled)throw Error('New project is disabled');b.click();return 'new project requested'})()
